   167	shifted by the Σ-family of `Z` and by `m` inverse powers of the pinned θ-family.

   171	plus class by the same two factors.  A point of `chartLocus` is precisely a point at which

   174	def chartTwist (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   175	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T) : picEt C T :=
   176	  lam * (thetaFamily C (thetaCechClass C) T ^ m) * (sigmaFamily C Z T)⁻¹
   177	
   178	/-- **The degree ledger of the twist**: at every field point the twisted family has fibre
   179	degree `m·d₁ − deg Z` when `λ` is degree-zero.  With the chart-index constraint
   180	`deg Z = m·d₁ − g` this is `+g`, which is the degree at which an effective witness with
   181	`h¹ = 0` can exist at all.

   183	**Sign discipline, and it was wrong here until 2026-07-28 (issue I-0514).**  `chartTwist`
   184	must be the INVERSE of `chartValue`'s twist, not the same one.  `chartValue` is
   185	`abelDiv · Σ · (θᵐ)⁻¹` (`DivSchemeAbel.lean:351`), so recovering the Abel class from a chart
   186	value means multiplying by `θᵐ` and dividing by `Σ` — hence `chartTwist` is
   187	`λ · θᵐ · Σ⁻¹`.  An earlier version applied the `chartValue` twist itself, giving fibre degree
   188	`deg Z − m·d₁ = −g`; since `Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(W))` forces `deg W ≥ g − 1`, that locus was

   191	`pic0`), NOT at `n = 0`.

   194	wrong sign survived two sessions: at `deg W = g` the rank anchor

160	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum` over `A` whose fibre witness predicate at every residue field agrees
   161	with the split witness predicate of `μ` at the corresponding point.
   162	
   163	Two remarks on the shape, both deliberate:
   164	
   165	* it is stated as an **agreement of predicates at every point**, not as a class equality.
   166	  That is weaker than "the datum's class is `μ`", and it is all the openness argument
   167	  consumes — which matters, because the class equality is what needs `cechPicClass_inv` and
   168	  a class-level identification, whereas a lane that can produce the pointwise agreement by any
   169	  other route may use this theorem immediately;
   170	* the split predicate is read at `Over.testPoint`, i.e. at the canonical residue-field point
   171	  of the affine test, so no choice of affine chart enters;
   172	* the `Algebra A (testPointField t)` / `IsScalarTower k A (testPointField t)` instances the
   173	  datum predicate needs are the **canonical** ones of `Picard/Pic0ChartTestPoint.lean`.  An
   174	  earlier draft of this file carried them as explicit `alg`/`tow` arguments; that was strictly
   175	  worse — it made the statement false for some regradings (`HasWitnessH1Vanishing` reads its
   176	  `Algebra` instance inside `relCurveMap`, so a non-canonical `alg` names a different set) as
   177	  well as unusable. -/
   178	def IsChartDatumPresentation {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   179	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)) (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π) : Prop :=
   180	  ∀ t : (overSpec k A).left,
   181	    D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
   182	      ↔ IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ)
   183	
   184	/-! ## The carrier translation: `testPointField` on `Spec A` versus `Ideal.ResidueField`
   185	
   186	The engine's open set lives in `PrimeSpectrum A` and is indexed by `q.asIdeal.ResidueField`;
   187	`chartLocus` lives in `(overSpec k A).left = Spec A` and is indexed by `Over.testPointField`.
   188	The two carriers are the same space, but the two *fields* are only canonically isomorphic
   189	(mathlib's `Spec.residueFieldIso`), so the witness predicate has to be carried across that
   190	isomorphism.  That is what this section does, and it is the transport the (b-amendment) folds
   191	into "affine pieces glue by (V1c)-style locality". -/
   192	
   193	/-- **The residue-field comparison at a point of an affine test, as an algebra map.**
   194	
   195	`Over.testPointField t` is the *scheme* residue field `(Spec A).residueField t`, while every
   196	engine-facing predicate reads the *algebraic* residue field `t.asIdeal.ResidueField` of the
   197	prime.  Mathlib's `Spec.residueFieldIso` identifies them; this records the identification in
   198	the form the tower needs, namely that the canonical `A`-algebra structure on the scheme
   199	residue field (`Over.instAlgebraTestPointFieldAffine`) factors through the algebraic one.
   200	
   201	Proof: both sides are `Spec.preimage` of a morphism out of `Spec κ(t)`, and `Spec.map` is
   202	injective on homs, so it suffices to compare after applying `Spec.map` — where the identity is
   203	mathlib's `Spec.map_residueFieldIso_inv_eq_fromSpecResidueField`. -/
   204	lemma algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine_factors {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   205	    (t : (overSpec k A).left) :
   206	    algebraMap A (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
   207	      = ((Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (.of A) t).inv).hom.comp
   208	          (algebraMap A (t : PrimeSpectrum A).asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
   209	  rw [Over.algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine]
   210	  have h : Spec.preimage ((overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t)
   211	      = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (t : PrimeSpectrum A).asIdeal.ResidueField)
   212	          ≫ (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (.of A) t).inv := by
   213	    apply Spec.map_injective
   214	    rw [Spec.map_preimage, Spec.map_comp]
   215	    exact (Scheme.Spec.map_residueFieldIso_inv_eq_fromSpecResidueField (.of A) t).symm
   216	  rw [h]
   217	  rfl
   218	
   219	/-- **The witness predicate at a scheme-residue field agrees with the one at the prime's
   220	residue field, and the resulting locus is open.**
   221	
   222	`Over.testPointField t` is `(Spec A).residueField t` and the engine reads
   223	`t.asIdeal.ResidueField`; `Spec.residueFieldIso` identifies them, and the witness predicate
   224	transfers along any field extension in the `A`-tower
   225	(`hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension`, `Pic0ChartLocusFibreField.lean:142`), in
   226	particular along an isomorphism.
   227	
   228	Three points about the proof, each of which was a suspected wall and is not:
   229	
   230	* the **carrier identification** `↥(overSpec k A).left = PrimeSpectrum A` is *definitional*
   231	  (`Scheme.Spec`'s carrier is `PrimeSpectrum` on the nose), so the two index sets need no
   232	  transport and the two topologies agree by `rfl`.  The set equality below is therefore a
   233	  pointwise `Iff`, not a homeomorphism argument;
   234	* the `Algebra A (testPointField t)` and `IsScalarTower k A (testPointField t)` instances the
   235	  predicate needs are **already canonical** (`Over.instAlgebraTestPointFieldAffine`,
   236	  `Over.instIsScalarTowerTestPointFieldAffine`), so nothing has to be passed in as an
   237	  argument.  An earlier draft of this file took `alg`/`tow` as explicit hypotheses and left
   238	  the conclusion as a `sorry`; that was a statement-shape artifact, not a gap — and worse,
   239	  the hypothesis form is *false for some regradings*, since an arbitrary `alg` need not be the
   240	  canonical instance and the predicate is not invariant under regrading the field over `A`;
   241	* the only genuine content is the transport across `Spec.residueFieldIso`, which is
   242	  `hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension` applied to the isomorphism, in the tower
   243	  `A → κ(q) → (Spec A).residueField t` supplied by
   244	  `algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine_factors`. -/
   245	theorem isOpen_setOf_hasWitnessH1Vanishing_testPointField
   246	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom) {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   247	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π) :
   248	    IsOpen {t : (overSpec k A).left |
   249	      D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)} := by
   250	  -- The two loci are the SAME set of the SAME type: `↥(overSpec k A).left` is
   251	  -- `PrimeSpectrum A` definitionally, so only the fibre field differs, and the predicate is
   252	  -- invariant under the isomorphism between the two readings of it.
   253	  have hset : {t : (overSpec k A).left |
   254	        D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)}
   255	      = {q : PrimeSpectrum A |
   256	          ∃ W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k q.asIdeal.ResidueField).left).CurveDivisor,
   257	            Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass q.asIdeal.ResidueField W
   258	                = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C A q.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   259	                    D.cechPicClass
   260	              ∧ Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   261	                  ((C ⊗ overSpec k q.asIdeal.ResidueField).left.divisorSheaf
   262	                    q.asIdeal.ResidueField W) 1)} := by
   263	    refine Set.ext fun t => ?_
   264	    -- the comparison iso as an algebra structure, and its tower over `A`
   265	    letI : Algebra (t : PrimeSpectrum A).asIdeal.ResidueField
   266	        (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) :=
   267	      ((Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (.of A) t).inv).hom.toAlgebra
   268	    haveI : IsScalarTower A (t : PrimeSpectrum A).asIdeal.ResidueField
   269	        (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) :=
   270	      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine_factors t)
   271	    exact (D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension
   272	      (t : PrimeSpectrum A).asIdeal.ResidueField
   273	      (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)).symm
   274	  rw [hset]
   275	  exact D.isOpen_setOf_exists_witness_h1_vanishing hπ
   276	
   277	/-! ## Transports (0) and (iii): the identification with the landed locus -/
   278	
   279	/-- **`chartLocus` over an affine test is the witness locus of a presenting datum.**
   280	
   281	This is transport (0) (the class-indexation, landed as `cechWitnessLocus`) composed with
   282	transport (iii) (locality on the affine test, here trivial because the test *is* affine),
   283	run against the presentation hypothesis.  The content is entirely the translation between
   284	the two ways the tree indexes a fibre — by a point of the test object's space
   285	(`Over.testPoint`, the `chartLocus` side) and by a prime of the test algebra
   286	(`q.asIdeal.ResidueField`, the engine side).
   287	
   288	The translation is available precisely because `Over.testPointField` at a point of
   289	`(overSpec k A).left = Spec A` and `q.asIdeal.ResidueField` at the corresponding prime are
   290	the same field up to the canonical `Spec.residueFieldIso`, and the witness predicate is
   291	invariant under field isomorphism over the base (`hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension`
   292	applied to an isomorphism). -/
   293	theorem mem_chartLocus_iff_hasWitnessH1Vanishing
   294	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   295	    {μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)} {D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π}
   296	    (hpres : IsChartDatumPresentation C π μ D) (t : (overSpec k A).left) :
   297	    IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ)
   298	      ↔ D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) :=
   299	  (hpres t).symm
   300	
   301	/-! ## The keystone, conditionally -/
   302	
   303	variable (C π) in
   304	/-- **`isOpen_chartLocus`, given the shifted-datum presentation** (dat-b row B-4's keystone,
   305	over an affine test).
   306	
   307	The proof is the route of record with the one missing link supplied as `hpres`: rewrite
   308	membership of `chartLocus` as the datum's witness predicate at the residue field of the
   309	point (the presentation), then quote the landed datum-level openness
   310	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.isOpen_setOf_exists_witness_h1_vanishing` — itself the engine
   311	`datumRigidEngine_isOpen_vanishing` read through the GAP-6 dictionary.
   312	
   313	The general-test statement follows from this one by the affine-piece locality of the
   314	(b-amendment)'s transport (iii): `chartLocus` over `T` meets each affine open `U ⊆ T.left` in
   315	`chartLocus` over `Spec Γ(T.left, U)` (by `picEtMap_chartTwist` along
   316	`Over.fromSpecAffine T U`), and a set that is open in every member of an open cover is open.
   317	That last step is `isOpen_iff_forall_isOpen_inter`-style bookkeeping and needs no new
   318	mathematics; it is not stated here only because it would need the presentation hypothesis
   319	*per affine piece*, which is a statement about the general test and therefore belongs with
   320	the honesty/presentation obligations named in the header table. -/
   321	theorem isOpen_setOf_isSplitWitness_of_presentation (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   322	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   323	    {μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)} {D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π}
   324	    (hpres : IsChartDatumPresentation C π μ D) :
   325	    IsOpen {t : (overSpec k A).left |
   326	      IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ)} := by
   327	  -- The engine's open set is indexed by primes of `A`; the locus is indexed by points of
   328	  -- `Spec A`.  These carriers are the same type, so the presentation rewrites one into the
   329	  -- other pointwise.
   330	  have hset : {t : (overSpec k A).left |
   331	        IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ)}
   332	      = {t : (overSpec k A).left |
   333	          D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)} :=
   334	    Set.ext fun t => mem_chartLocus_iff_hasWitnessH1Vanishing hpres t
   335	  rw [hset]
   336	  exact isOpen_setOf_hasWitnessH1Vanishing_testPointField hπ D

    12	/-!
    13	# Native presentations for split field classes
    14	
    15	A residue-field H¹ witness for the lambda-tied cocycle datum supplies its arbitrary-ring
    16	cohomology and rank certificates.  The native all-cartesian base-change theorem then completes
    17	the corresponding `PicRankOneNativePresentation` without a separate pushforward hypothesis.
    18	
    19	A split genus-degree class over a field stays split after every affine coefficient extension,
    20	so it supplies those witnesses for each pullback datum.
    21	
    22	The final theorem is the direct public consumer: a split field class belongs to
    23	`PicRankOneOpen`, because every affine pullback receives the presentation constructed here.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	set_option autoImplicit false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28	
    29	universe u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    32	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    33	
    34	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    35	
    36	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    37	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    38	
    39	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    40	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    41	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    42	
    43	noncomputable section
    44	
    45	/-- Every morphism between affine tests over `Spec k` is induced by a `k`-algebra map.
    46	
    47	Unlike `exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom`, neither coefficient ring is required to be a
    48	field.  This is the form needed when the target of a field-valued Picard point is tested by an
    49	arbitrary affine scheme. -/
    50	theorem exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing
    51	    (R S : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra k R] [Algebra k S]
    52	    (t : overSpec k S ⟶ overSpec k R) :
    53	    ∃ e : R →ₐ[k] S, t = Over.overSpecMap e := by
    54	  have hw : t.left ≫ (overSpec k R).hom = (overSpec k S).hom := Over.w t
    55	  let psi : CommRingCat.of R ⟶ CommRingCat.of S := Spec.preimage t.left
    56	  have hmap : Spec.map psi = t.left := Spec.map_preimage t.left
    57	  have htower : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R) ≫ psi =
    58	      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k S) := by
    59	    apply Spec.map_injective
    60	    rw [Spec.map_comp, hmap]
    61	    exact hw
    62	  let e : R →ₐ[k] S :=
    63	    { __ := psi.hom
    64	      commutes' := fun r ↦
    65	        congrArg (fun f => f r) (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom htower) }
    66	  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
    67	  ext : 1
    68	  exact hmap.symm
    69	
    70	/-- Complete the native presentation attached to an actual lambda-tied datum.
    71	
    72	The input is exactly the remaining family-level H¹ obligation.  The degree law follows from the
    73	two class equalities stored in `P`; finiteness, projectivity, and rank one follow from the
    74	arbitrary-ring certificate theorem; and native pushforward base change is the canonical
    75	all-cartesian theorem.  Thus every field concerns the same cocycle datum. -/
    76	noncomputable def PicRankOneNativeDatum.toNativePresentation_of_residueH1Witness
    77	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    78	    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    79	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    80	    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
    81	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    82	    (hres : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier,
    83	      P.datum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    84	    PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam :=
    85	  PicRankOneNativePresentation.ofCertificatesWithNativeBaseChange
    86	    P.cover P.representative P.represents P.datum P.datum_class
    87	      (RankOneFamilyCertificates.ofActualDatum P.datum hpi hres
    88	        (fun L ↦ P.classDeg_baseChange L))
    89	
    90	/-- The arbitrary-affine pullback of a split field class has a complete native presentation.
    91	
    92	The datum is the representative extracted from the displayed pullback `lam`.  Its residue-field
    93	H¹ witnesses come from `hsplit`, while its degree law comes from the equality with `lam`.
    94	Consequently all four cohomology/rank fields and the native base-change field concern the same
    95	cocycle datum. -/
    96	theorem PicRankOneNativePresentation.nonempty_of_fieldPullback
    97	    {K A : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    98	    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    99	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   100	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   101	    (e : K →ₐ[k] A) (nu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   102	    (hlam : lam.1 = picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap e) nu)
   103	    (hsplit : IsSplitWitness C nu) :
   104	    Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) := by
   105	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := PicRankOneNativeDatum.nonempty (C := C) pi lam
   106	  exact ⟨P.toNativePresentation_of_residueH1Witness hpi
   107	    (P.residueH1Witness_of_fieldPullback e nu hlam hsplit)⟩
   108	
   109	/-- A split genus-degree class over a field belongs to the public rank-one Picard locus.
   110	
   111	Every affine test morphism into `Spec K` is induced by a `k`-algebra map `K → A`; the
   112	preceding producer therefore supplies the exact native presentation required on that pullback.
   113	-/
   114	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness
   115	    (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
   116	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   117	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   118	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K))
   119	    (hsplit : IsSplitWitness C lam.1) :
   120	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k K)) := by
   121	  apply mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations pi
   122	  intro A _ _ t

   215	  exact ⟨z * w, by rw [map_mul, hz, hw, map_mul]⟩
   216	
   217	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] in
   218	variable (C) in
   219	/-- Honesty is closed under inversion. -/
   220	theorem IsPlusHonest.inv {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {μ : picEt C T}
   221	    (hμ : IsPlusHonest C T μ) :
   222	    IsPlusHonest C T μ⁻¹ := by
   223	  intro U
   224	  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hμ U
   225	  exact ⟨z⁻¹, by rw [map_inv, hz, map_inv]⟩
   226	
   227	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] in
   228	variable (C) in
   229	/-- Honesty is closed under powers. -/
   230	theorem IsPlusHonest.pow {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {μ : picEt C T}
   231	    (hμ : IsPlusHonest C T μ) (m : ℕ) :
   232	    IsPlusHonest C T (μ ^ m) := by
   233	  intro U
   234	  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hμ U
   235	  exact ⟨z ^ m, by rw [map_pow, hz, map_pow]⟩
   236	
   237	variable (C) in
   238	/-- **A θ-family is honest at every test** — the first half of the non-vacuity check.
   239	
   240	`thetaFamily_natural` restricts a θ-family to a θ-family, and `thetaFamily_overSpec_affineEquiv`
   241	says its affine collapse is the plus unit of the base-changed base class.  So a θ-family is in the
   242	range of the unit on every affine piece, with no hypothesis on the curve.
   243	
   244	This is why `chartTwist` preserves honesty: two of its three factors are θ-families. -/
   245	theorem thetaFamily_isPlusHonest (L₀ : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic)
   246	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
   247	    IsPlusHonest C T (thetaFamily C L₀ T) := by
   248	  intro U
   249	  refine ⟨relPicAlgMap C (Algebra.ofId k Γ(T.left, U.1)) (relPicMk C (overSpec k k) L₀), ?_⟩
   250	  rw [thetaFamily_natural]
   251	  exact (picEtAffineEquiv C Γ(T.left, U.1)).injective (by
   252	    rw [picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt, thetaFamily_overSpec_affineEquiv])
   253	
   254	variable (C) in
   255	/-- A Σ-family is honest: it *is* a θ-family (`sigmaFamily` is defined as one). -/
   256	theorem sigmaFamily_isPlusHonest (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   257	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
   258	    IsPlusHonest C T (sigmaFamily C Z T) :=
   259	  thetaFamily_isPlusHonest C _ T
   260	
   261	variable (C π) in
   262	/-- **THE ABEL VALUE IS HONEST AT EVERY TEST** — the witness that carries weight, and the one this
   263	file's header cited by name before it existed (see the header's own retraction).
   264	
   265	The θ- and Σ-family witnesses above are the *twist factors*, which `chartTwist_isPlusHonest`
   266	discharges anyway; they say nothing about the class being charted.  Since
   267	`chartValue = abelDiv · Σ · (θᵐ)⁻¹` and honesty is a subgroup condition, honesty of a **chart
   268	value** reduces to honesty of `abelDiv` — so this is the row that makes CHART-U(b) unconditional
   269	on the classes DAT-C's Σ-chart actually reads.
   270	
   271	It is cheap for a structural reason: `abelDiv`'s components are `abelDivPlus`, i.e. `PicEtAff.unit`
   272	of `relPicMk` of the family's class, and `relPicToPicEt`'s components are `PicEtAff.unit` of
   273	`relPicMap` — so the witness on the piece `U` is the class of the *restricted* family, and
   274	`abelDiv_val` plus `picEtMap_abelDiv` line the two up. -/
   275	theorem abelDiv_isPlusHonest {n : ℕ} (T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   276	    (s : divFamZar C π n T) :
   277	    IsPlusHonest C T (abelDiv C π n T s) := by
   278	  intro U
   279	  refine ⟨relPicMk C (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1))
   280	    ((divFamZarAffineEquiv C π n Γ(T.left, U.1)
   281	      (divFamZar.map C π n (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) s)).picClass), ?_⟩
   282	  rw [picEtMap_abelDiv, abelDiv_overSpec]
   283	  rfl
   284	
   285	variable (C) in

events.text: A promising route is now visible in landed code: arbitrary affine classes already have a lambda-tied native datum, and that datum can become a full native presentation once every residue fibre is split. The missing work may therefore be the geometric packaging of the pointwise split locus as an open of an arbitrary test, plus the exact factorization equivalence, rather than new cohomology machinery.

    12	/-!
    13	# The lambda-tied datum underlying a native rank-one presentation
    14	
    15	Every affine Picard value is represented on an etale cover. This file exposes that actual
    16	representative and refines its relative Picard class to a basic-open cocycle datum. The output is
    17	tied to the displayed value; it makes no cohomology, rank, evaluation-divisor, or base-change
    18	claim.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    23	
    24	universe u
    25	
    26	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    27	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    28	
    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    30	
    31	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    32	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    33	
    34	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    35	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    36	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    37	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    38	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    39	
    40	/--
    41	The part of a native presentation forced by the displayed Picard value.
    42	
    43	`represents` ties the etale-plus representative to `lam`, while `datum_class` ties the
    44	basic-open cocycle datum to that same representative. The geometric certificates that enrich
    45	this datum are intentionally absent.
    46	-/
    47	structure PicRankOneNativeDatum
    48	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    49	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    50	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    51	  represents :
    52	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    53	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    54	  datum_class :
    55	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    56	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    57	
    58	namespace PicRankOneNativeDatum
    59	
    60	/-- Every displayed affine Picard value has a tied basic-open cocycle datum.
    61	
    62	The proof exposes an etale-plus representative of the displayed value, chooses a Cech
    63	representative of its relative Picard class, and refines that class to a basic-open datum.
    64	-/
    65	theorem nonempty
    66	    (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    67	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) :
    68	    Nonempty (PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam) := by
    69	  have hplus : ∀ a : PicEtAff C A,
    70	      ∃ (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses C E),
    71	        PicEtAff.mk C E x = a := by
    72	    intro a
    73	    induction a using PicEtAff.ind with
    74	    | mk E x => exact ⟨E, x, rfl⟩
    75	  obtain ⟨E, x, hrep⟩ := hplus (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)
    76	  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := relPicMk_surjective C (overSpec k E.Carrier)
    77	    (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier))
    78	  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_cechPicClass_eq
    79	    (C := C) (B := E.Carrier) (π := pi) c
    80	  refine ⟨
    81	    { cover := E
    82	      representative := x
    83	      represents := hrep
    84	      datum := D
    85	      datum_class := ?_ }⟩
    86	  calc
    87	    (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) =
    88	        relPicMk C (overSpec k E.Carrier) c := hc.symm
    89	    _ = relPicMk C (overSpec k E.Carrier) D.cechPicClass :=
    90	      congrArg (relPicMk C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) hD.symm
    91	
    92	noncomputable local instance (priority := 20000) nativeDatumDegreeOver
    93	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    94	    (relCurve C L).Over (Spec (.of L)) :=
    95	  instOverBaseChange C L
    96	
    97	noncomputable local instance nativeDatumDegreeSmooth
    98	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    99	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
   100	  instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
   101	
   102	noncomputable local instance nativeDatumDegreeIntegral
   103	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
   104	    IsIntegral (relCurve C L) :=
   105	  instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
   106	
   107	noncomputable local instance nativeDatumDegreeQuasiCompact
   108	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
   109	    QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
   110	  instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
   111	
   112	noncomputable local instance nativeDatumDegreeFiniteH0
   113	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
   114	    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
   115	  instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L
   116	
   117	noncomputable local instance nativeDatumDegreeFiniteH1
   118	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
   119	    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
   120	  instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L
   121	
   122	/-- The datum extracted from a genus-degree class has genus degree after every field-valued
   123	coefficient extension.
   124	
   125	This is forced by the two class-identification fields of `P`; it is not an additional rank-one
   126	hypothesis. -/
   127	theorem classDeg_baseChange
   128	    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
   129	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   130	    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
   131	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier L]
   132	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L] :
   133	    classDeg L
   134	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   135	        P.datum.cechPicClass) = genus C :=
   136	  PicRankOneLocalPresentation.datum_classDeg_baseChange_of_representation
   137	    P.cover P.representative P.represents P.datum P.datum_class L
   138	
   139	/-- Split witnesses for the represented class on every residue field give the exact residue
   140	`H¹` witnesses for the same extracted datum.
   141	
   142	The proof first identifies the datum with its relative Picard representative, uses the existing
   143	pointwise presentation equivalence, and then transports across the canonical comparison between
   144	the scheme-theoretic and algebraic residue fields. -/
   145	theorem residueH1Witness_of_isSplitWitness
   146	    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
   147	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   148	    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
   149	    (hsplit : ∀ t : (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier).left,
   150	      IsSplitWitness C
   151	        (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t)
   152	          (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   153	            (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))))) :
   154	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier,
   155	      P.datum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField := by
   156	  intro p
   157	  have hfib : IsChartDatumPlusFibre C pi
   158	      (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   159	        (relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) P.datum.cechPicClass))
   160	      P.datum :=
   161	    isChartDatumPlusFibre_of_relPicToPicEt C pi
   162	      P.datum.cechPicClass P.datum rfl
   163	  have hpres := isChartDatumPresentation_of_plusFibre_tower C pi hfib
   164	  have hs : IsSplitWitness C
   165	      (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint
   166	        (show (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier).left from p))
   167	        (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   168	          (relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) P.datum.cechPicClass))) := by
   169	    simpa only [← P.datum_class] using hsplit p
   170	  have hp : P.datum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing
   171	      (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) p) :=
   172	    (hpres p).mpr hs
   173	  letI : Algebra p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   174	      (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) p) :=
   175	    ((Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (.of P.cover.Carrier) p).inv).hom.toAlgebra
   176	  haveI : IsScalarTower P.cover.Carrier p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   177	      (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) p) :=
   178	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
   179	      (algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine_factors p)
   180	  exact (P.datum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension
   181	    p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   182	      (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) p)).mpr hp
   183	
   184	end PicRankOneNativeDatum
   185	
   186	end AlgebraicGeometry

     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RankOneFamilyCertificatesActualDatum
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneFamilyCertificates
     9	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneFamilyCertificatesH0BaseChange
    10	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneNativePresentationDatum
    11	
    12	/-!
    13	# Native rank-one certificates for the lambda-tied datum
    14	
    15	This file closes the Picard-side consumer boundary.  A `PicRankOneNativeDatum` already records
    16	that its etale representative presents the displayed lambda and that its basic-open cocycle datum
    17	represents that same relative Picard class.  Residue-field split witnesses therefore produce the
    18	four cohomological certificates for this exact datum over its arbitrary affine coefficient ring.
    19	
    20	The returned package uses the canonical `h0BaseChange` and `scalarExtension` operations from
    21	`RankOneFamilyCertificates`; `h0BaseChange_tower` proves their coherence along every affine
    22	coefficient tower.  The final constructor passes the package directly to
    23	`PicRankOneNativePresentation.ofCertificates`.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	set_option autoImplicit false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28	
    29	universe u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    32	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    33	
    34	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    35	
    36	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    37	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    38	
    39	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    40	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    41	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    42	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    43	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    44	variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    45	
    46	namespace PicRankOneNativeDatum
    47	
    48	/-- The pointwise split condition on the displayed lambda representative carried by `P`. -/
    49	abbrev ResidueSplitWitnesses (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam) : Prop :=
    50	  ∀ t : (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier).left,
    51	    IsSplitWitness C
    52	      (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t)
    53	        (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
    54	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))))
    55	
    56	/-- Produce the complete arbitrary-affine certificate package for the lambda-tied datum `P`.
    57	
    58	The H1 input is converted from split witnesses for `P.representative`; the degree law is derived
    59	from `P.represents` and `P.datum_class`.  Finiteness and projectivity are constructed at a genuine
    60	finite Noetherian stage and transported back, rather than supplied by the caller. -/
    61	noncomputable def familyCertificates
    62	    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
    63	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    64	    (hsplit : P.ResidueSplitWitnesses) :
    65	    RankOneFamilyCertificates P.datum :=
    66	  RankOneFamilyCertificates.ofActualDatum P.datum hpi
    67	    (P.residueH1Witness_of_isSplitWitness hsplit)
    68	    (fun L ↦ P.classDeg_baseChange L)
    69	
    70	/-- Canonically extend the lambda-tied certificate package to any affine coefficient algebra. -/
    71	noncomputable def familyCertificatesBaseChange
    72	    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
    73	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    74	    (hsplit : P.ResidueSplitWitnesses)
    75	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
    76	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
    77	    RankOneFamilyCertificates (P.datum.baseChange B) :=
    78	  (P.familyCertificates hpi hsplit).scalarExtension B
    79	
    80	end PicRankOneNativeDatum
    81	
    82	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
    83	
    84	/-- Assemble a native rank-one presentation from the actual lambda-tied datum and its split
    85	witnesses.  The only remaining independent input is the native pushforward base-change theorem. -/
    86	noncomputable def ofNativeDatum
    87	    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
    88	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    89	    (hsplit : P.ResidueSplitWitnesses)
    90	    (hpush :
    91	      ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    92	        (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    93	        (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
    94	        (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    95	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g),
    96	        IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.datum.nativeModule)) :
    97	    PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam :=
    98	  PicRankOneNativePresentation.ofCertificates
    99	    P.cover P.representative P.represents P.datum P.datum_class hpush
   100	      (P.familyCertificates hpi hsplit)
   101	
   102	end PicRankOneNativePresentation
   103	
   104	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# CHART-U(b) AT A GENERAL TEST: `isOpen_chartLocus`, and the advertised lemma that did not exist
    10	
    11	`Picard/Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen.lean` proves `isOpen_setOf_isSplitWitness_of_presentation` over an
    12	**affine** test, and its docstring says the general-test statement "follows from this one by the
    13	affine-piece locality of the (b-amendment)'s transport (iii) … needs no new mathematics".  That
    14	claim is right, and this file discharges it — but two of its ingredients were not where the tree
    15	said they were.
    16	
    17	## The advertised lemma that was absent
    18	
    19	`Picard/Pic0ChartTestPoint.lean`'s header says chart-independence of the residue field is free
    20	"and the chart comparison becomes a lemma (`testPointField_affineOpen_iso`) instead of a side
    21	condition.  That is the whole reason this file is short."  **No declaration of that name exists
    22	anywhere in the workspace** — the only occurrence was that sentence (cf. I-0624:
    23	advertised-but-absent).  Since it is cited as the reason a side condition is unnecessary, it is
    24	load-bearing prose, so it is supplied here as `testPointField_fromSpecAffine_isIso`.
    25	
    26	It is genuinely cheap, but not for the reason the header gives: what makes it work is that
    27	`Over.fromSpecAffine T U` is an **open immersion** on carriers
    28	(`IsAffineOpen.isOpenImmersion_fromSpec`), and mathlib already knows the residue-field map of an
    29	open immersion is an isomorphism
    30	(`Scheme.instIsIsoCommRingCatResidueFieldMapOfIsOpenImmersion`).  So the comparison is an
    31	iso for a structural reason, not by a computation with `Spec.residueFieldIso`.
    32	
    33	## Locality: what "open in every affine piece" needs
    34	
    35	`isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open`-style bookkeeping is not quite enough, because the locus over the
    36	piece is a subset of a *different* space (`Spec Γ(T.left, U)`, not `T.left`).  The bridge is that
    37	`fromSpecAffine`'s carrier map is an open immersion with range `U`, so the image of the piece's
    38	locus is the intersection of `chartLocus` with `U` — that is what
    39	`chartLocus_inter_affineOpen_eq_image` records, and the openness statement then follows from
    40	openness of an open immersion's image.
    41	
    42	## Main declarations
    43	
    44	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.testPointField_fromSpecAffine_isIso` — **the absent advertised lemma**:
    45	  the residue-field comparison along an affine-open test object is an isomorphism.
    46	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isSplitWitness_fromSpecAffine_iff` — hence the split-witness predicate
    47	  at a point of an affine piece agrees with the one at its image in `T`; this is transport (i)'s
    48	  hypothesis `hinv` **discharged** for the affine-piece maps (both directions), rather than

    31	  the datum-level export**: on the vanishing locus (fibre degree `n`, `χ = 1 − n`),
    32	  `Module.rankAtStalk (H⁰(F_D)) p = 1`.  Route: `Module.rankAtStalk_eq` reads the rank as
    33	  the `κ(p)`-fibre dimension; `datumH0BaseChange` (on the nose) identifies the fibre with
    34	  `H⁰(C_{κ(p)}, F_{D_{κ(p)}})`; the fibre computation above pins it at `1`.
    35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamily.rankAtStalk_divisorDatum_eq_one` — the
    36	  certified-family specialization (**N1**): for `G` landing in the h¹-vanishing locus
    37	  `V`, the divisor datum `D_G := G.adaptation.divisorDatum` has invertible `H⁰`.  The
    38	  fibre-degree hypothesis is discharged uniformly by `DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass` (the
    39	  fibre class has `classDeg = n` at every field).
    40	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamily.exists_fibrewise_generator_divisorDatum`
    41	  — **N3, the generator kit**: since `H⁰(F_{D_G})` is projective of rank `1` (hence has a
    42	  nontrivial fibre at every prime of the locus), a fibrewise-nonzero **global** section
    43	  exists Zariski-locally (`Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective`).
    44	
    45	Noetherian discipline (worksheet §2): every rank statement carries `[IsNoetherianRing S]`
    46	through the engine; the arbitrary-test consumers reach it through RE-5 stages.
    47	-/
    48	
    49	set_option autoImplicit false
    50	/- Statements mix `relCurve C L` with the product spelling `(C ⊗ overSpec k L).left`. -/
    51	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    52	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161). -/
    53	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    54	
    55	universe u
    56	
    57	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
    58	open scoped TensorProduct
    59	
    60	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    61	
    62	open AlgebraicJacobian Scheme
    63	
    64	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    65	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    66	
    67	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    68	variable {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
    69	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] {n : ℕ}
    70	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    71	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    72	
    73	/-- The standing `C.left`-over-`k` structure, keyed on `C.hom` — the instance the base
    74	χ-normalization `hχ : χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n` is phrased against (defeq to `.ofHom C.hom`, so
    75	`chi_moduleKSheaf C` unifies with it). -/
    76	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftRankOne : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
    77	
    78	/-! ## The χ transport to the fibre curve -/
    79	
    80	/-- **`χ(𝒪) = 1 − n` at every field extension**, from the base normalization
    81	(`chi_moduleKSheaf` at the base-changed bundle + `genus_baseField`; a re-derivation of the
    82	`DivSchemeMonoBridgeRel` private lemma). -/
    83	theorem chi_relCurve (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
    84	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    85	    Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) = 1 - (n : ℤ) := by
    86	  haveI : IsProper (baseChangeBundle C L).hom := instIsProperSndLeft C L
    87	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
    88	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionSndLeft C L
    89	  haveI : GeometricallyIrreducible (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
    90	    instGeometricallyIrreducibleSndLeft C L
    91	  have h1 : Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L)
    92	      = 1 - (genus (baseChangeBundle C L) : ℤ) := chi_moduleKSheaf (baseChangeBundle C L)
    93	  have h2 : genus (baseChangeBundle C L) = genus C := genus_baseField C L
    94	  have h3 : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (genus C : ℤ) := chi_moduleKSheaf C
    95	  have h4 : (genus C : ℤ) = (n : ℤ) := by rw [h3] at hχ; linarith
    96	  rw [h1, h2, h4]
    97	
    98	/-! ## The fibre computation: `h⁰(C_L, F_{D_L}) = 1`
    99	
   100	The fibre geometric instances (`Curve.BaseChangeInstances`) are threaded as instance
   101	arguments — they cannot be synthesized through the `relCurve` `def` barrier, so consumers
   102	install them by `haveI` (the `degAt_abelDiv` block, I-0249 (iv)) before calling. -/
   103	
   104	/-- **The fibre h⁰ pin**: for a datum whose fibre class over the field `L` has
   105	`classDeg = n`, with the base χ-normalization and vanishing `H¹` of the base-changed
   106	sheaf, the fibre global-section count is exactly `1` — the Riemann–Roch rank anchor
   107	`h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi` read through the presentation bridge
   108	`presentationSheafIso`, at `n + (1 − n)`. -/
   109	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one
   110	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C S π)
   111	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
   112	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra S L] [IsScalarTower k S L]
   113	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C L)]
   114	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))]
   115	    [QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))]
   116	    [Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0)]
   117	    [Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1)]
   118	    (hg : classDeg L (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ))
   119	    (hsub : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange L).sheaf 1)) :
   120	    Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf = 1 := by
   121	  set P : (relCurve C L).MeromorphicPresentation :=
   122	    Scheme.MeromorphicPresentation.ofCocycle (D.baseChange L).pointedCover
   123	      (gluedSubordCocycle (D.baseChange L).isGluingCocycle
   124	        (D.baseChange L).pointedCover (D.baseChange L).pieceIndex
   125	        fun _ => le_rfl) with hP
   126	  have hsubP : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (P.gluedSheaf L) 1) :=
   127	    (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv (presentationSheafIso (D.baseChange L)) 1).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mp
   128	      hsub
   129	  have h0eq : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf = Sheaf.h0 (P.gluedSheaf L) :=
   130	    Sheaf.h0_congr (presentationSheafIso (D.baseChange L))
   131	  have hformula := h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi L P hsubP
   132	  have hPclass : P.picClass = (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass := rfl
   133	  have hint : (Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf : ℤ) = 1 := by
   134	    rw [h0eq, hformula, hPclass, hg, chi_relCurve hχ L]; ring
   135	  exact_mod_cast hint
   136	
   137	/-! ## Σ-RANK1: the rank-1 export on the vanishing locus -/
   138	
   139	/-- **Σ-RANK1, the datum-level rank export** (worksheet GAP-3): on the fibrewise
   140	h¹-vanishing locus, at fibre degree `n` with the base χ-normalization `χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n`,
   141	the datum engine's `H⁰` has stalk-rank exactly `1` at `p`.
   142	
   143	`Module.rankAtStalk_eq` reads the rank as the `κ(p)`-dimension of the fibre
   144	`κ(p) ⊗[S] H⁰`; the on-the-nose base change `datumH0BaseChange` identifies this fibre with
   145	`H⁰(C_{κ(p)}, F_{D_{κ(p)}})`, whose dimension is `1` by the fibre computation. The global
   146	fibrewise hypothesis `hfib` supplies finiteness/projectivity (hence flatness) through
   147	`datumRigidEngine`. -/
   148	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one
   149	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C S π) [IsNoetherianRing S]
   150	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   151	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
   152	    (hfib : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S,
   153	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[S] q.asIdeal.ResidueField))
   154	    (p : PrimeSpectrum S)
   155	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField)]
   156	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
   157	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   158	    [QuasiCompact
   159	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   160	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   161	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0)]
   162	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   163	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1)]
   164	    (hg : classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   165	      (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ)) :
   166	    Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p = 1 := by
   167	  obtain ⟨-, hfin, hproj⟩ := datumRigidEngine D hπ hfib
   168	  haveI := hfin
   169	  haveI := hproj
   170	  have hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1 := datum_subsingleton_pairH1 D hπ hfib
   171	  have hfibre : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf = 1 :=
   172	    D.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one hχ p.asIdeal.ResidueField hg
   173	      (D.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1)
   174	  calc Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p
   175	      = Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   176	          (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[S] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)) :=
   177	        Module.rankAtStalk_eq p
   178	    _ = Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   179	          (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf 0) :=
   180	        (D.datumH0BaseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1).finrank_eq

1	/-

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartTwistSplit
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneNativePresentationDatum
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Descent of the split-witness condition along a field embedding
    11	
    12	`isSplitWitness_map_overSpecMap_of_algHom` (`Picard/Pic0RankOneNativePresentationField`)
    13	transports a split witness *up* an arbitrary extension of its reading field.  This file
    14	proves the converse: if the pullback of a class `ν` over `K` along a field embedding
    15	`e : K →ₐ[k] K'` is a split witness, then `ν` itself already is.  Together the two make
    16	the split-witness condition on a field class *intrinsic to the underlying point*, which
    17	is exactly what lets the rank-one split locus be computed on any carrier and transported
    18	down cover maps.
    19	
    20	The proof splits `ν` over a finite separable `L/K` and destructures the hypothesis'
    21	splitting `L'/K'`, presents both Čech classes by basic-open cocycle data, and compares
    22	them over a common finite separable extension `P/L'`: a field factor of the base change
    23	to `L'` of the field cover `L/K`.  Over `P` the two presenting classes agree — both
    24	present the pushforward of `ν`, and the plus unit (étale separatedness, C1) together
    25	with `relPicMk`-injectivity at a one-point base identifies them at the Čech level — so
    26	the witness `H¹`-vanishing predicates of the two data coincide there, and field-location
    27	invariance walks the witness from `L'` down to `L`.
    28	
    29	The auxiliary finite map `pi` is used only to choose the basic-open cocycle data through
    30	which the `H¹` witness is transported.
    31	-/
    32	
    33	set_option autoImplicit false
    34	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    35	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    36	
    37	universe u
    38	
    39	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    40	open TopologicalSpace Opposite
    41	
    42	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    43	
    44	open AlgebraicJacobian
    45	
    46	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    47	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    48	
    49	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    50	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    51	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    52	
    53	noncomputable section
    54	
    55	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
    56	-- Two instance towers (one per splitting field) and the compositum transport need the
    57	-- larger budget, exactly as in the upward-transport template.
    58	/-- **Split-witness descent along an arbitrary field embedding** — the converse of
    59	`isSplitWitness_map_overSpecMap_of_algHom`: if the pullback of `ν` along
    60	`Spec K' → Spec K` is a split witness then so is `ν`.
    61	
    62	No finiteness, separability, or algebraicity assumption is imposed on `e`.  The witness
    63	is not read off over the hypothesis' splitting field directly: both splittings are
    64	compared over a finite separable field factor of the base change of the `ν`-side
    65	splitting field, where étale separatedness identifies the presenting Čech classes, and
    66	the witness then descends by field-location invariance of the `H¹` predicate. -/
    67	theorem isSplitWitness_of_overSpecMap
    68	    (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    69	    {K K' : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Field K'] [Algebra k K']
    70	    (e : K →ₐ[k] K') (nu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
    71	    (h : IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap e) nu)) :
    72	    IsSplitWitness C nu := by
    73	  -- split `ν` over a finite separable `L/K`, and present the splitting by a datum
    74	  obtain ⟨L, hLf, hkL, hKL, htowkKL, hLfin, hLsep, M, hM⟩ :=
    75	    exists_splitting_of_picEt C nu
    76	  letI := hLf
    77	  letI := hkL
    78	  letI := hKL
    79	  letI := htowkKL
    80	  letI := hLfin
    81	  letI := hLsep
    82	  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ :=
    83	    BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_cechPicClass_eq (C := C) (B := L) (π := pi) M
    84	  -- destructure the split witness of the pullback, and present its splitting too
    85	  obtain ⟨L', hL'f, hkL', hK'L', htowkK'L', hL'fin, hL'sep, M', hM', W', hW'cl, hW'1⟩ := h
    86	  letI := hL'f
    87	  letI := hkL'
    88	  letI := hK'L'
    89	  letI := htowkK'L'
    90	  letI := hL'fin
    91	  letI := hL'sep
    92	  obtain ⟨D', hD'⟩ :=
    93	    BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_cechPicClass_eq (C := C) (B := L') (π := pi) M'
    94	  -- the `K`-algebra structures on `K'` and `L'`, through `e`
    95	  letI hKK' : Algebra K K' := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    96	  haveI htowkKK' : IsScalarTower k K K' :=
    97	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (e.commutes x).symm
    98	  letI hKL' : Algebra K L' := ((algebraMap K' L').comp e.toRingHom).toAlgebra
    99	  haveI htowKK'L' : IsScalarTower K K' L' := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
   100	  haveI htowkKL' : IsScalarTower k K L' := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
   101	    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k K' L']
   102	    change algebraMap K' L' (algebraMap k K' x)
   103	      = algebraMap K' L' (e (algebraMap k K x))
   104	    rw [e.commutes]
   105	  -- the common field `P`: a finite separable field factor of `L' ⊗[K] L` over `L'`
   106	  obtain ⟨P, hPf, hL'P, hPfin, hPsep, ⟨q⟩⟩ :=
   107	    ((Algebra.EtaleCover.ofField (K := K) L).baseChange
   108	      L').exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom
   109	  letI := hPf
   110	  letI := hL'P
   111	  letI := hPfin
   112	  letI := hPsep
   113	  letI hkP : Algebra k P := ((algebraMap L' P).comp (algebraMap k L')).toAlgebra
   114	  haveI htowkL'P : IsScalarTower k L' P := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
   115	  letI hK'P : Algebra K' P := ((algebraMap L' P).comp (algebraMap K' L')).toAlgebra
   116	  haveI htowK'L'P : IsScalarTower K' L' P := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
   117	  haveI htowkK'P : IsScalarTower k K' P := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
   118	    change algebraMap L' P (algebraMap k L' x)
   119	      = algebraMap L' P (algebraMap K' L' (algebraMap k K' x))
   120	    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k K' L']
   121	  letI hKP : Algebra K P := ((algebraMap L' P).comp (algebraMap K L')).toAlgebra
   122	  haveI htowKL'P : IsScalarTower K L' P := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
   123	  haveI htowkKP : IsScalarTower k K P := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
   124	    change algebraMap L' P (algebraMap k L' x)
   125	      = algebraMap L' P (algebraMap K L' (algebraMap k K x))
   126	    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k K L']
   127	  haveI htowKK'P : IsScalarTower K K' P := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
   128	  -- the embedding of the `ν`-side splitting field into `P`
   129	  set sigma : L →ₐ[K] P :=
   130	    ((q.restrictScalars K).comp
   131	        ((Algebra.EtaleCover.ofField (K := K) L).baseChangeInclude L')).comp
   132	      (Algebra.EtaleCover.ofFieldEquiv (K := K) L).symm.toAlgHom with hsigma
   133	  letI hLP : Algebra L P := sigma.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   134	  haveI htowKLP : IsScalarTower K L P :=
   135	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (sigma.commutes x).symm
   136	  haveI htowkLP : IsScalarTower k L P := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
   137	    change algebraMap k P x = sigma (algebraMap k L x)
   138	    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k K L, sigma.commutes,
   139	      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k K P]
   140	  -- both data present their own classes at their own base fields
   141	  have hidL : Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C L L) D.cechPicClass
   142	      = D.cechPicClass := by
   143	    have hmap : relCurveMap C L L = 𝟙 (relCurve C L) := by
   144	      rw [relCurveMap]
   145	      have hbase : overSpecMap (k := k) L L = 𝟙 (overSpec k L) :=
   146	        Over.OverMorphism.ext (by simp)
   147	      rw [hbase, MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_id]
   148	      rfl
   149	    rw [hmap, Scheme.CechPic.map_id]
   150	    rfl
   151	  have hidL' : Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C L' L') D'.cechPicClass
   152	      = D'.cechPicClass := by
   153	    have hmap : relCurveMap C L' L' = 𝟙 (relCurve C L') := by
   154	      rw [relCurveMap]
   155	      have hbase : overSpecMap (k := k) L' L' = 𝟙 (overSpec k L') :=
   156	        Over.OverMorphism.ext (by simp)
   157	      rw [hbase, MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_id]
   158	      rfl
   159	    rw [hmap, Scheme.CechPic.map_id]
   160	    rfl
   161	  -- the hypothesis' witness, read as the fibre predicate of `D'` at `L'`
   162	  have hWitL' : D'.HasWitnessH1Vanishing L' :=
   163	    ⟨W', by rw [hidL', hD', hW'cl], hW'1⟩
   164	  -- push both presenting equations to `P`
   165	  have hMP : PicEtAff.map C P (picEtAffineEquiv C K nu)
   166	      = PicEtAff.unit C P
   167	          (relPicMk C (overSpec k P) (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C L P) M)) := by
   168	    have hmap := congrArg (PicEtAff.map C P) hM
   169	    rw [PicEtAff.map_map, PicEtAff.map_unit, relPicAlgMap_mk] at hmap
   170	    exact hmap
   171	  have hM'P : PicEtAff.map C P
   172	        (picEtAffineEquiv C K' (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap e) nu))
   173	      = PicEtAff.unit C P
   174	          (relPicMk C (overSpec k P)
   175	            (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C L' P) M')) := by
   176	    have hmap := congrArg (PicEtAff.map C P) hM'
   177	    rw [PicEtAff.map_map, PicEtAff.map_unit, relPicAlgMap_mk] at hmap
   178	    exact hmap
   179	  -- over `P` both present the same class: the pushforward of `ν`
   180	  have hnat : PicEtAff.map C P
   181	        (picEtAffineEquiv C K' (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap e) nu))
   182	      = PicEtAff.map C P (picEtAffineEquiv C K nu) := by
   183	    rw [picEtAffineEquiv_naturality]
   184	    change PicEtAff.map C P (PicEtAff.map C K' (picEtAffineEquiv C K nu)) = _
   185	    rw [PicEtAff.map_map]
   186	  -- étale separatedness + `relPicMk`-injectivity: Čech-level agreement over `P`
   187	  haveI : Subsingleton (overSpec k P).left :=
   188	    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum P))
   189	  have hclP : Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C L P) M
   190	      = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C L' P) M' :=
   191	    relPicMk_injective_of_subsingleton C (overSpec k P)
   192	      (PicEtAff.unit_injective C P (hMP.symm.trans (hnat.symm.trans hM'P)))
   193	  have hclD : Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C L P) D.cechPicClass
   194	      = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C L' P) D'.cechPicClass := by
   195	    rw [hD, hD']
   196	    exact hclP
   197	  -- chain the witness: `L' → P` (up), congr across the class identity, `P → L` (down)
   198	  have hWitP : D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing P :=
   199	    (D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_congr_of_cechPicClass_eq D' P hclD).mpr
